points.quote: `affine/` is the Affine editor built on that framework.
`store`: the Yjs-backed document model (docs, blocks, schemas, transactions).
`std`: the runtime that renders and drives the editor. It covers block views, selection, commands, services and the canvas/gfx runtime.
`widgets`: floating UI such as toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle... `fragments`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title and adapter-panel.
Nothing inside `blocksuite/` imports from the rest of the repo, but the rest of the repo imports it about 1,170 times.
